title: console_setting
description: The Console settings: one record for the whole Console, edited by a super admin in the Access station (Sign-in box). Today it holds one setting: how many minutes of inactivity before the Console signs a person out (see CONSOLE_SETTING_GUIDE.md). Rules the schema cannot express: exactly one record exists (settings_key is always default); only a super admin may change it (access/policy.py); any signed-in Console user may read it, because the page needs the number to know when to lock; a missing record means the Console uses 10 minutes; fields marked readOnly are set by the server only.
x_retention: Kept. The record is replaced in place; every change is also written to the activity log (activity_events). (A written policy only.)

settings_key.description: Always default. It makes the one-record rule checkable, because ids are UUIDs. Required.

session_timeout_minutes.description: Minutes without a click, key press, scroll or touch before the Console signs the person out and asks for the key or Google sign-in again. Whole minutes, 1 to 480 (8 hours). There is no off setting. Required. Starting value 10.

id.description: UUID v4, set by the server; also the Firestore document id.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema the record was written under (currently 1). Set by the server.

created_at.description: When the record was created (UTC). Set by the server.

created_by.description: Who created it, as an actor string. Set by the server.

updated_at.description: When the record last changed (UTC). Set by the server.

updated_by.description: Who last changed it. Set by the server.

source.description: Where the record came from: dashboard or import. Set by the server.

deleted_at.description: When the record was soft deleted (UTC); absent while live. Set by the server.

deleted_by.description: Who soft deleted it. Set by the server.
